d.d: Of, from, or pertaining to Czechia, the Czech people, culture, or language.
A person from the Czech Republic (Czechia) or of Czech descent.
A Slavic language primarily spoken in the Czech Republic.
A country in Central Europe. Official name: Czech Republic. Capital and largest city: Prague.
A native or inhabitant of Czechoslovakia.
Of, pertaining to, or characteristic of Czechoslovakia or its people.
Of or pertaining to the former nation of Czechoslovakia.
